_meta.purpose: The pre-registered thresholds of the stream-mode diagnoses (inc_autopilot/diagnose_stream.py), each with the reason it has its value, in thresholds.json's house style. They live in their own file, not in a 'stream' block of thresholds.json, because diagnose.rules_version() hashes thresholds.json whole: a stream block there would change the experiment-mode rules version and re-diagnose the live experiment campaigns (docs/CONTINUOUS_LOOP.md, Build notes, group F).
_meta.writers: A person or a deploy, never the running platform (contract 6.5, S27): floor_gb and floor_su are derived from the measured first collection wave and written here by a person; a null floor is a placeholder, and L16 is not autonomous while it stands (contract 7.4, 10 R3).

low_water_M_mult.why: Contract 6.4 D20: the DATA lane collects while the eligible target images are below 2M, the low-water mark, so that a full increment is always in reserve when a segment is cut.

deficit_segments.why: Contract 6.4 D20: a species is in deficit when the queue holds fewer of its target boxes than the last 2 segments consumed.

discover_after_days.why: Contract 6.4 D20 and 6.7: with no open candidate, discovery (L15) runs again when the last run is more than 7 days old.

verify_rate_default.why: The expected share of a candidate's declared target boxes that survive the guards and the verifier, used only to rank candidates when the candidate states no expected count; contract 7.3 expects 4.4k-10.4k verified of about 16.6k raw target boxes (0.27-0.63), and 0.5 is the midpoint. Ranking only: nothing is admitted on it.

deficit_bonus.why: A candidate that declares a deficit species (D20's list, or a species D33 names) ranks as if it yielded (1 + bonus) times its expected boxes per GB: contract 6.4 D20/D33 ask for a bonus without a size; 1.0 doubles the rank, which puts any deficit source above a non-deficit source of equal yield.

floor_gb.why: Contract 7.4: verified target boxes admitted per GB below which a source is closed. Set by a person from the measured first D-C wave; null is the placeholder, under which D21 does not evaluate and L16 is not autonomous.

floor_su.why: Contract 7.4: verified target boxes admitted per SU of collect + admit. Set by a person from the first wave; null is the placeholder.

min_gb.why: Contract 6.4 D21: a source is judged only after min(2 GB, the whole source) has been fetched.

cut_M_mult.why: Contract 5.3: a segment is cut when Q >= 4M (K = 4 increments).

stale_days.why: Contract 5.3: or when Q >= M and the oldest eligible row is at least 7 days old.

K_max.why: Contract 5.3 and P2: K <= 4 increments per segment; supply, not SU, limits the loop, and shorter segments give earlier boundary checks.

accepted.why: Contract 5.5: a milestone after 4 accepted increments since the last one.

days.why: Contract 5.5: or after 30 days with at least one accepted increment.

boundary_sd_mult.why: Contract 5.5: the boundary check fires when mean(new base seeds) < mean(old) - 2 sd(old); at 3 v 3 it is an alarm, not a claim. D25 applies it to the means and sd the stream summary's boundary_check records (inc2.stream), not to its 'fires' flag.

perm_p.why: Contract 3.6: a milestone rolls back only on the one-sided 5 v 5 permutation test at p <= 0.025 with mean(new) < mean(old) (as FUNNEL_AUDIT H10a). inc2.stream compare computes the test; D25 proposes L21 only when the recorded p and means meet this value, and hands a disagreement to a person. A species-guard-only 'hurts' does not roll back (D33, X17).

walltime_share.why: Contract 6.4 D26: hold builds when the projected longest run of the next build is at least 0.8 of its walltime limit (cold 8 h, incremental 3 h, build 4 h), before a run times out the way the round scheduler's did on 2026-08-29.

quota_free_frac.why: Contract 6.6 and decision L-7: pause when staging + projected bytes leave less than 3 % of the /ocean quota free (about 210 GB of the 6.84 TiB project quota, which the whole lab shares). Measured 2026-09-28: 454 GB free (94 % used); the stream's projected need is under 50 GB. Before collection starts, free space must also cover collect_gb_envelope.

renewal_card_days.why: Contract 6.6: the allocation renewal card is raised 30 days before the allocation's end date.

source_alpha.why: Contract 6.4 D28 as amended on 2026-09-29 (decision L-9; the funnel's amendment A2, docs/FUNNEL_AUDIT.md 14): a source is a leak and is quarantined (L24) when one of its images is within 6 dHash bits of an evaluation image under any of the 8 variants, or when its embedding hits are improbable under the copy detector's per-image false-positive rate: P(Binom(images, p_false) >= hits) < 0.001 (inc2.embed_calibration.source_verdict), p_false being the v2 calibration's one-sided 97.5 % upper bound. It replaces 'never_train_share >= 0.05': at a per-image rate p a source of n images holds about n p chance hits, so a share rule quarantines by a source's size and domain, not by copying (at the funnel's first threshold, 805 of 1,915 3SeasonWeedDet10 2022 images were flagged, none a capture-session copy).

base_copy_share.why: Contract 6.4 D28: or with at least 20 % base copies (a re-upload of the base's own photographs).

recent_days.why: Contract 6.4 D29: collection is exhausted when an L15 run in the last 14 days found nothing new and no open candidate is predicted above the floor.

backoff_days.why: Contract 6.7 review: WAIT_DATA re-runs discovery after 7, then 14, then 30 days, and never COMPLETEs (P7).

share_min.why: Contract 6.4 D30 review: TRAIN holds when at least half of the last decided segment's REJECTs are recipe-caused in the guard reading of 3.5 (only the regression guard failed).

blames_to_quarantine.why: Contract 6.4 D31: a source blamed for data twice is quarantined (L24) and D21 closes it.

window.why: Contract 6.4 D32: no ACCEPT in the last 12 decided increments while D30 is silent holds L18 and raises a card; the DATA lane then runs at half cadence.

share.why: Contract 6.4 D33: the same species fails the species guard in at least half of a segment's REJECTs (realloop_v1: PricklySida, 5 of 6).

hold_after_segments.why: Contract 6.4 review: D33 also holds L18 once it has fired on 2 consecutive segments, so a species guard tripping on every step does not burn segments until D32.

p_band.why: Contract 6.4 'Recipe or data?': P_data in (0.25, 0.75), the gate's own HOLD band (GateConfig p_reject, p_accept).

share_min.why: Contract 6.4: underpowered when that holds on at least half of the decided steps.

max_doublings.why: Contract 6.3 L22: at most 2 doublings of M, then card X17.

p_reject.why: Contract 3.5 review: a REJECT is disposed 'data' at P_data <= p_reject (GateConfig p_reject 0.25) unless the step's truth arm says 'helps'. inc2.stream commit records every stream disposition; this value applies only where D30/D31/D33 read the pinned prior (realloop_v1) through the same rule, before Stage A is READY; the step's own recorded config.p_reject is used when the gate block set one.

truth_step_hours_max.why: Contract 2.6 L-4: a step whose cost with the truth arm exceeds 25 GPU-h runs the truth arm on every ceil(cost/25)-th step. inc2.stream applies the rule per segment from its own cost model; here it prices L18 proposals and enters the prospective stream record. The capacity switch rule itself (2 pooled sd on dev) is inc2.baseline capacity-verdict's, read from capacity/capacity_v1.json, not re-implemented here.

lane_fails.why: Contract 6.6: 2 consecutive failed steps in a lane hold that lane.

step_retries.why: How many times one step (stream.step_key: the lever and its policy params) is proposed again after it failed, whether or not the failures were consecutive; the next failure leaves it with a person (its lane held until a person releases it: stream release, or enable). The funnel's rule for its jobs (levers.json protocol funnel_job_retries). Each re-proposal carries a new id (the executor runs an id once; seen live on 2026-09-28: L23 re-proposed under its old id after its job failed was refused). The collection levers keep their per-source bound (7.5).

zero_yield_sources.why: Contract 6.6: 3 consecutive sources ending failed or with zero admitted target boxes hold the DATA lane; one zero-yield source is legitimate (a licence hold, a copy source), so 2 do not.

held_lanes_to_pause.why: Contract 6.6: the campaign pauses when 2 lanes are held.

errors_to_pause.why: Contract 6.6: the ticker raising on 3 ticks in a row pauses (campaign.ERRORS_TO_PAUSE).

deadline_days.why: Contract 6.7 review: a hold that waits on the funnel campaign (funnel_F9, h6_scan, the MH-Weed16 rejoin) carries a deadline 21 days after the row's admission; past it an h6_scan hold is served by the stream's own copy detector and a funnel_F9 hold becomes an R3 item for a person.

discover_min_hours.why: L15 runs at most once a day: discovery reads public provider APIs, and a daily cadence is far above the pace at which new public datasets appear (contract 11.1).

shadow_days.why: Contract 10 R3: shadow mode for at least 3 days (diagnose and propose only) before a person may set data_autonomy on.

min_lower_bound.why: Contract 3.3 (a proposed verifier-refit trigger, pre-registered here): a batch's known-truth verified precision whose Wilson lower bound falls under 0.99 (the in-domain precision was 99.96-100 %) raises card X11.

min_matched.why: Contract 3.3: on at least 30 matched verified boxes, so a handful of matches cannot trip it.

min_new_boxes.why: Contract 3.3: a species with at least 100 new target-labelled boxes ... (step1_stream lists such species in status.json refit_triggers.species_unknown_share with the same values, REFIT_SPECIES_NEW_BOXES and REFIT_SPECIES_UNKNOWN_SHARE; the per-species counts are not in its status).

max_unknown_share.why: Contract 3.3: ... of which at least half the verifier calls unknown.
